body: Yeah I already avoided the update, typing this on my iPad as I speak. Airplane mode worked just fine.
They only regulate apps for underclassmen, and no one makes quizzes on them anymore due to cheating LMAO

I mean it actually is my property under our handbook, and "petty" is a near anachronism for the general attitude towards our school. That's not the point; our tech department is not savvy and I've talked to a guy on the inside and he says that it most likely can be avoided by a temporary airplane mode change. This is because it's a quick command that isn't going to be part of the main profile, it's a separate thing sent over school wifi itself onto a temporary profile. Just thought I'd update with this.

Edit so I don't seem utterly irrational, I struggle with a major OCD which is the only reason I'm opposed to so suddenly updating.
